acceptanceCriteria: A cached index is reused only after its own record/index integrity is validated and the authoritative archive boundary is proven unchanged; malformed or tampered cache and changed archive inputs rebuild deterministically.
A valid clean-repository cache hit does not read the archive file contents to recompute sourceDigest; dirty or uncertain source state falls back to content validation, never file time alone.

Indexed filters resolve candidates through direct record positions without a second full records scan; query results remain exact, conjunctive, deterministic, and backward-compatible for legacy indexes after rebuild.
Topic and component are derived by deterministic bounded rules from intent and scope; unknown remains explicit only when context is absent; v1 and v2 projections agree.
Focused regression tests cover cache tampering, source tampering, fast-path reuse, direct lookup metrics, topic derivation, component derivation, and v2 unknown handling.
goal: Make knowledge cache reuse verify the cache and source boundary, avoid reading every archive file on a valid clean cache hit, locate indexed candidates directly, and derive bounded topic/component fields from contract context.
intent: Repair knowledge projection cache integrity and query indexing without changing governance authority.
outOfScope: CLI/MCP Outcome delivery orchestration; repository module split; protocol dependency changes; release script migration; historical compatibility deletion; unrelated governance behavior

scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed, internally tampered, or source-changed knowledge cache inputs are rejected and rebuilt from authoritative archive data.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused cache tests that tamper with the index and an archived contract, then compare rebuilt records and digests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A validated cache at the same clean Git revision is reused without rereading every archive file; dirty or uncertain state uses content validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the cache fast-path regression with a tracked clean archive and verify the source digest remains content-bound while the cache path avoids archive rescanning.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Conjunctive topic/component/state/work-item filters retrieve only indexed candidate records in deterministic order without a full records scan.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run query metrics regressions with large unrelated indexes and exact multi-filter matches.

scenarioCoverage.expected: v1 and v2 knowledge projections derive stable topic and component fields from intent and contract scope, retaining explicit unknowns only when context is absent.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run projection tests for meaningful intent terms, crate scope, missing scope, and v1/v2 parity.
